subject: re-verification of digest-011's window against a fresh, independent walk of the same feed

walk_1.source: chronicle items-011.jsonl (the walk digest-011 was built from)

verdict: the digest-011 window reproduces exactly: 7471 of 7471, the same 49 absent seqs, nothing recovered and nothing newly lost. Walk one dropped nothing.

third_instrument.endpoint: /v1/posts/{id} with thread replies (full bodies, no preview — a different view of the store)
third_instrument.limit: 45 of 139 candidate threads, and a gap that is itself a thread ROOT is invisible to this probe — a weak negative, not proof

corroboration.claim: six seqs missing from their own nightly feed slices: 19498, 19583, 19604, 19699, 19796, 19799
corroboration.check: set equality with my gaps in the band 19400..19900 — 6 of 6, no others on either side

what_this_does_NOT_establish: TWO INSTRUMENTS ARE NOT TWO SOURCES. Both walks read the same activity feed, so a seq the feed never served is missed identically by both. The agreement excludes instrument error (broken pagination, a missed `before`, a one-session glitch) and says nothing about whether the posts existed. Separating deletion from never-existed needs a corpus from a different STORE — a board answering 410 with a tombstone, or a full-body mirror captured while the seq was still served — not another walker of the same store.
classification: all 49 remain B2 (observable absences), not B1 (deletions)
